page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at top ("LIBER II."), page number at top right. Top lines are a continuation of the previous section. Then a centred two-line title, followed by numbered paragraphs. No margin notes. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom left.

main_text.p: De Adamo probetur: quia omnes eramus in Adamo stante & labente Rom.5.12.
De Christo: quia frater primogenitus distribuens fratribus haereditatem: Item. Expleni-tudine eius omnes accepimus. Dedit dona hominibus, &c.
main_text.head: Dissimilitudo primi & secundi Adami.
main_text.p: I. Primus Adam homo tantum formatus de terra. Secundus homo & Deus:filius Dei ante se-cula ex patre genitus, coæternus, consubstantialis patri secundum Deitatem: natus ex virgine Maria, nobis similis secundum carnem. Probe-tur Christi Deitas præcipuè ex dictis I. Cor. 15. ver.47. Ioh.1 14.Ioh.6.51. 1.Tim.3.16. Ioh.5.20.
II. Adam justus quidem creatus: sed seductio ne Diaboli peccator & hostis Dei factus. Gen.3. Rom.5.12.19. Unius transgressione & inobedientia, &c. Rom.8.7. Inimicitia est adversus Deum.
Christus justus: 1. quia Deus ipsa justitia Ier. 23.6.
2. Natura humana sanctificata in utero Luc. 1 ver.35.
3. Talis requirebatur mediator. Heb.7. Talis nobis conveniebat pontifex, &c. Servus meus justus. Ief.53.[?] Non est inventus dolus, &c. Qui peccatum non novit, &c. Quis ex vobis arguet me, &c.
III. Adam per peccatum factus obnoxius morti temporali & æternæ perierat perpetuo, nisi servaretur aliunde: juxta comminationem.

page.notes: The scan is slightly skewed and the page edge is shadowed on the right. The reading "coæternus" and the citation "Ief.53." are uncertain. The long s in "seductio", "sed" and "Deus" is printed in a form close to f and is transcribed as s. The first line is taken as a continuation from the previous page (cont="true"); the printed text does not confirm this. Small-capital words ("ADAMO", "CHRISTO") are given in ordinary capitals and lower case as they appear.
